proposals.evidence: Turner lists Gujarati/Marathi sāp and the wider Prakrit sappa snake family. These short western Bhil hāp/hap forms retain that stem with the regional s-to-h correspondence also seen in the saved dry/needle series. Compound responses containing another snake word, and -ḍ/-l-expanded stems, are excluded.
